title: The outdoor spoil/ridge exploration grid north of Cinderhall (Iron Downs) is large and visually repetitive with little wayfinding signal, so locating the Hundred Gallery entrance and the Flooded Quarry (slag-hound den) took extensive undirected backtracking (~30 turns).
